description.value: Rewind Beer Co is a Port Moody brewery tasting room with a time-travel theme, pouring a rotating lineup of house-brewed craft beers alongside guest taps and ciders. The tasting room doubles as a pizza kitchen, serving creative wood-fired pies available for dine-in. It's a lively neighbourhood spot with a full non-alcoholic beverage selection and regular food features.
